source_caption_text:
Drake and Timbaland were lowkey competing for who could make the funniest face 😭😭

Drake and Timbaland were both making some ridiculous faces throughout the “Say Something” video. They were taking the performance so seriously, which somehow made every expression even funnier.

The two of them kept switching between intense stares, exaggerated looks and random facial expressions like they were acting out every single line. You can barely watch the video without noticing what they’re doing with their faces.

It’s such a funny time capsule of that era. Young Drake and Timbaland were clearly having fun with the video, and those faces are probably the first thing people remember when they revisit it now.
